title: Day 1 patch
body: Cannoli 1.0 went live yesterday, so naturally here's the obligatory day-one patch. A round of launch-week fixes and polish from your feedback, rolled up below.

title: Battle early or make up a week
body: When you start a battle you can now pick which week it counts for — play ahead up to two weeks, or make up a missed match any time.

title: Nickname your Pokemon
body: Name your roster from the new Manage Roster panel on your team page. Nicknames show under each sprite, with the species name on hover.

title: Complete National Dex+ data
body: Types and learnsets are rebuilt from the latest data. The tier list now shows types for every Pokemon (Paradox and Legendaries included), and coverage no longer drops moves like Moltres's Defog.

title: Search the draft pool
body: A unified search bar on the draft board — filter the pool by name, type, move, ability or cost, with suggestions as you type.

title: Watch any replay in-app
body: Every Season 9, 10 and 11 replay now plays right inside Cannoli — no trip to Showdown required.

title: A fresh coat of paint
body: Animated backgrounds on the login and replay pages, plus subtle 3D tilt and glow on the sidebar league gems. Effects scale back automatically on lower-powered devices.

title: Season 11 is here
body: The tier list and draft costs have been rebuilt on the new National Dex+ scaling, and the rules page is synced to match. Jet Punch is now unbanned on Palafin.

title: Matchup Center is now public
body: Scout matchups without signing in. Playing on Showdown still requires a login.

title: Edit tera captains any time
body: Change your tera captains and their tera types at any point during the season, not just before it starts.

title: Upload your own team logo
body: Team owners can now upload a custom logo straight from their team page.

title: Smoother updates
body: The site now recovers gracefully right after an update instead of showing a stale-page error, with new behind-the-scenes error tracking so issues get caught faster.
